sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: The suffix -ba/-be expresses movement into a place or destination. It contrasts with -ban/-ben for being inside a place.

The same vowel harmony rule that picks -ban vs -ben also picks -ba vs -be here — back-vowel words like konyha take -ba, front-vowel words take -be. If you’ve already got the -ban/-ben harmony down, this one is nearly free; it’s the same ear-training applied to a new job.
